description: This file is an abstract base class for unit testing search functionalities in the SuiteCRM project, providing utility methods for invoking private/protected methods and setting private properties via reflection, and extending a PHPUnit framework test case.

classes.name: SearchTestAbstract
classes.description: An abstract base class for search-related unit tests, providing utility functions for reflective access to protected/private methods and properties, and ensuring proper cleanup after tests.

methods.name: invokeMethod
methods.description: Uses reflection to invoke a protected or private method of a given object with specified parameters.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Uses reflection to set the value of a private or protected property of an object.
